images.filename: Bank of Italy Building entrance, 552 Montgomery St., SF.JPG
images.caption:
This is an image of a place or building that is listed on the National Register of Historic Places in the United States of America. Its reference number is 78000754 (Wikidata).

The entrance to the Bank of Italy building at 552 Montgomery Street in San Francisco, now a First Bank branch.  This building was the headquarters of the Bank of Italy from 1908-1921, which later became Bank of America.
